assertions.assertion: Program.cs configures AddJwtBearer with Authority set to the IdentityServer URL
Program.cs sets MapInboundClaims = false on the JWT Bearer handler
assertions.rationale: options.MapInboundClaims = false is present on the JWT Bearer handler.

assertions.assertion: Program.cs sets TokenValidationParameters with NameClaimType = 'name' and RoleClaimType = 'role'
Program.cs sets Audience or ValidAudience to 'catalog-api'
assertions.rationale: options.Audience and ValidAudience are both set to "catalog-api".
UseAuthentication() precedes UseAuthorization() in the pipeline.
